programme.title: Kom Ons Braai: Celebs

programme.title: Kom Ons Braai: Celebs

programme.title: Veld Tot Fees
programme.desc: 'S1/E5'. Nampo Kaap is waar die veld die fees raakgeloop het! Van skaapskeer tot 'n vinnige inloer by die Elgin-vallei en dan nog lekker marimbamusiek - soos konfyt op roosterbrood - wat meer kan 'n mens voor vra?

programme.title: Die Tuinmakers
programme.desc: 'S1/E6'. Hugo van Niekerk se wêreld draai om ontwerp, plante en gemeenskap. Hy skep ruimtes waar mense kan speel, rus en bymekaarkom.

programme.title: Landbouweekliks
programme.desc: 'S31/E9'. PF Theron se Dwars-in-die-weg-boerdery doen iets buitengewoon in die hartjie van die dorre Karoo buite Matjiesfontein in die Wes-Kaap. Hier is 'n hoogs gespesialiseerde groentesaadvermeerdering-onderneming aan die groei.

programme.title: Bietjie Brittanje
programme.desc: 'S1/E6'. Mia Vorster bly in die Verenigde Koningkryk. In dié reeks besoek sy ander Suid-Afrikaners wat nou ook hier nesskrop en saam gesels hulle oor hul twee wêrelde.

programme.title: Veld Tot Fees
programme.desc: 'S1/E6'. Voordat die span Nampo Kaap vir oulaas besoek en groet, loer Anlie in by 'n kaasmaker van formaat, en stop oor by die uitsonderlike Jakes Gerwel Skool op Bonnievale.

programme.title: Mooi Praatjies
programme.desc: 'S2/E1'. Cindy Nell-Roberts gesels oor die 'skinification'-tendens. Efraine wys hoe om die 'clean make-up look' te kry. Dr. Maureen Allem van Skin Renewal gesels oor velgesondheid, terwyl Amor Vittone haar skoonheidsgeheime deel.

programme.title: Dorpie-doenlys

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Tiny Desk Concerts Japan
programme.desc: QUBIT, carrying on the spirit of Yellow Magic Orchestra, join us as they bring their signature electronic sound to NHK's Shibuya office.

programme.title: Bosai: Science That Can Save Your Life
programme.desc: Japan is one of the most volcanically active nations - its world-leading research on volcanic disasters has led to new technologies to track underground magma and predict phreatic eruptions.

programme.title: Carving The Spirit Of Fishermen
programme.desc: Hokkaido / Takeya Takayuki (Model Maker): Fishing boats in the herring industry that thrived here until the 1950s featured swirling decorations that made a big impression on Hokkaido native Takeya.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Yokai
programme.desc: Kijimuna of Okinawa - a red-haired child spirit in banyan trees - brings fortune to fishermen but punishes betrayal, embodying nature in local life.

programme.title: Magical Japanese
programme.desc: The Japanese language is rich in words and expressions influenced by nature, history and culture - this episode looks at words related to grass. Explore the unique culture behind them.

programme.title: Matsuri: The Heartbeat Of Japan
programme.desc: Gojinjo Taiko is a wild and powerful performance by masked drummers - it originated 400 years ago when villagers disguised themselves as oni (demons) to scare away a warlord's army.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Quantum Entanglement
programme.desc: Is quantum entanglement real, or just a misunderstanding? The question confounded Einstein and ruined the lives of many physicists - this is the story of a 100-year mystery that changed physics.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Broadcasters' Eye
programme.desc: A derailment accident occurred on the JR Fukuchiyama Line in 2005 - this programme reveals the 'invisible scars' of those who lost family, endure endless treatment, or search for meaning in surviving.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: J-Melo
programme.desc: Experience the cutting edge of Japanese entertainment as we turn the spotlight on virtual artists - this time, the all-male VTuber group HOLOSTARS.

programme.title: Little Charo
programme.desc: Animation series about a Japanese dog who meets and is helped by many mythical creatures of northern Japan as he searches for eight star talismans.

programme.title: Japanology Plus Mini
programme.desc: Sweet potatoes are often baked or turned into sweets in Japan, but they can also be used to generate electricity or protect from heat - we introduce the diverse ways in which they are used and sold.

programme.title: A Cat's-Eye View Of Japan
programme.desc: Kotaro likes to go for walks near the mausoleum for Date Masamune, a famous historical lord - Komimi, who lives in a glass workshop, has a surprising spot where she likes to drink water.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Anime Manga Explosion
programme.desc: Explore the evolution of sports manga and anime as critic Fujitsu Ryota discusses the genre's history and we go behind the scenes of Medalist to see how the artists create such realistic depictions.

programme.title: Rockie And Her Friends
programme.desc: Puppet action show for children. In a distant post-human future where surviving creatures have formed a community, new-breed dinosaur girl Rockie sets out on hilarious adventures with her schoolmates.

programme.title: Texico
programme.desc: Learn programming principles without a computer! Animated characters provide fun and lucid explanations of five core processes: analysis, combination, generalisation, abstraction and simulation.

programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Somewhere Street
programme.desc: Davao, located on Mindanao Island, is home to 1.7 million people - global business such as call centres are now thriving here, and the city is often cited as one of the safest in the Philippines.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Ramen Japan
programme.desc: Enjoy Tonkotsu ramen, which is loved by Okayama locals with a classic topping - pork cutlet - and a fragrant chicken broth bowl!

programme.title: Core Kyoto Mini
programme.desc: Hina dolls which represent the emperor, empress and imperial court are presented to girls on the first 3rd of March after they are born as part of Girls' Day celebrations.

programme.title: Easy Japanese For Work
programme.desc: This time: obtaining permission. Tran Van Vuong from Vietnam works as a fishing rod designer and tends to use 'daijoobu' instead of 'yoroshii' - by role-playing, he learns how to ask for permission.

programme.title: Zero Waste Life
programme.desc: Judo instructor Sato Hitoe uses worn-out uniforms (gis) to make items like tote bags - very durable since the original material was meant to be tough, behind it all is Sato's love for judo.
